d: A 4-billion-year-old piece of Mars has been discovered in the Sahara Desert, Mali. Named Teghaza 001, this rare Martian meteorite could unlock secrets about the Red Planet’s ancient history. NASA-linked scientists have studied its zircon crystals, uranium content, mineral composition and oxygen isotopes to uncover evidence of ancient water on Mars. Could this discovery offer new clues about Mars’ habitability and the possibility of microbial life?
